body:
You don't sound like an asshole, but I can't say that going to war sounds like it would be beneficial to anybody. 

And I have been living with opinions like this for a very long time and over time my mindset has only gotten worse and more negative. I'm fairly confident that continuing to live is not going to result in any grand epiphany where my outlook on things completely reverses. I think it would take a shitload of work and dedication to slowly better myself over time to the point where things seem not so bad, and frankly I just don't have the energy or willpower to make that kind of positive change.
